description: This file declares the AttachSamples class, which is a task for attaching media samples (audio and video) to a media pipeline in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes definitions for data structures representing audio and video data, and references external interfaces and classes related to media processing.

classes.name: AttachSamples
classes.description: A class representing a task to attach media samples (audio and video) to a media pipeline, including data structures for audio and video data.

methods.name: AttachSamples
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with media context, player interface, and media segments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task of attaching media samples to the pipeline.
